_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Biology Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 12, Topics 12.1-12.7. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column is omitted for the reasons documented in the Grade 10 file. As in Grade 10 and 11, the body's own Topic numbering and ordering differs from the front-matter Table of Contents: the ToC lists 'The Soil' under Grade 10, but the instructional body table places it here as Grade 12 Topic 12.6; the ToC also lists 'Population' (Unit 7) and 'Ecology' (Unit 8) as separate units, while the body nests Population as sub-topic 12.7.3 within one larger Topic 12.7 Ecology. This file follows the body throughout since it is the authoritative outcome content. A few small numbering skips exist in the source (printed outcome codes occasionally jump a digit, e.g. under 12.2.2, 12.4.2 and 12.4.4); outcomes are numbered sequentially here rather than reproducing those gaps. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 12 is modeled as a single term here.
